decisions.decision: DPW to contact landowner of Arnold Litch cemetery in hopes of coming to an agreement to preserve the site.

decisions.decision: Begin work restoring headstones and walls at Goodrich Cemetery and address table stones and hanging tree limbs at South Cemetery.

decisions.decision: Begin work on historic site markers this spring and finalize a list of the most important sites.
